_doc: Hand-curated corrections applied on top of the in-game scan. Every entry needs a reason. See docs/04-arquitectura.md (pipeline).

worldBossPseudoInstances._reason: Encounter Journal 'raids' whose map is a whole continent; they list world bosses, not instances.

worldBossLockouts._reason: EJ pseudo-instance -> how the weekly kill is known. savedWorldBoss = listed by GetSavedWorldBossInfo (Raid Info 'World Bosses'). Mists and Draenor world bosses appear there; to be confirmed in game. Missing = unknown (Verification Required): Battle for Azeroth world bosses use hidden weekly quests instead.
worldBossLockouts._reason1028: Battle for Azeroth world bosses (Kraulok) rotate weekly and are marked by an epic world quest named after the boss: worldQuest = the addon finds that quest on the boss's map, remembers its ID and reads active / completed (icy-veins.com, Blizzard forums).

extraSources._reason: Boss mount drops the Encounter Journal does not list, each verified by hand on Wowhead (item page) and warcraft.wiki.gg (item / JournalEncounterID pages). mountID = Mount Journal ID (warcraftmounts blizzardid, re-checked in game from the item with C_MountJournal.GetMountFromItem). dungeonEncounterID -> journalEncounterID is resolved in game (EJ_GetEncounterInfo over all encounter IDs, once). hiddenBoss = boss not in the journal: its kill cannot be read, so it stays To verify.

list.name: Reins of the Bronze Drake
list.reason: Infinite Corruptor, Culling of Stratholme Heroic, guaranteed if killed within 25 min of the first Scourge wave; not in the journal (warcraft.wiki.gg Reins_of_the_Bronze_Drake, wowhead item=43951)

list.name: Smoldering Ember Wyrm
list.reason: Nightbane, secret boss of Return to Karazhan; not in the journal (warcraft.wiki.gg Smoldering_Ember_Wyrm, wowhead item=142552)

list.name: Aerial Unit R-21/X
list.reason: King Mechagon hard mode, Operation: Mechagon Mythic (warcraft.wiki.gg Aerial_Unit_R-21/X, wowhead item=168830, JournalEncounterID page: King Mechagon 2260)

list.name: Grand Black War Mammoth (Emalon)
list.reason: Drops from all Vault of Archavon bosses (warcraft.wiki.gg Grand_Black_War_Mammoth); the journal lists it only under Archavon

instanceDifficulties._reason: Difficulties an instance really has. The Encounter Journal answers for a difficulty the instance lacks with another one's loot, so the scan saw drops there too.

76.name: Zul'Gurub
76.reason: Heroic only (Cataclysm 4.1). In game: 'Zul'Gurub is only available as a Heroic dungeon.' when set to Normal (reported by the player).

77.name: Zul'Aman
77.reason: Heroic only (Cataclysm 4.1), same as Zul'Gurub; no mount today, kept for consistency.

raidSkips._reason: Raid skips: a quest per difficulty (Normal 14 / Heroic 15 / Mythic 16); a higher one unlocks the lower ones (warcraft.wiki.gg). IDs from each quest's warcraft.wiki.gg page (external links, in Normal, Heroic, Mythic order); /aplan skips shows their titles in game to confirm. boss = English fallback when the journal name is not available.

vendorRequirements._reason: Requirements a vendor asks for that the mount item's tooltip does not show (Requirements.lua cannot read them). Checked by hand on warcraft.wiki.gg / Wowhead. reputation = factionID per player faction (UnitFactionGroup), standing = reaction (8 = Exalted), exceptRace = race file name that skips the requirement.

list.name: Armored Vorquin mounts
list.reason: Armored Vorquin Leystrider 198809, Swift Armored Vorquin 198810, Majestic Armored Vorquin 198811 (Treysh / Tethalash, 80 gold): non-Dracthyr must be Exalted with Obsidian Warders (Alliance, faction=2524) or Dark Talons (Horde, faction=2523). warcraft.wiki.gg item pages, faction IDs on Wowhead. Reported in game: the tooltip shows nothing.

holidayBosses._reason: World event bosses with a mount, queued from the Dungeon Finder once a day while their event is on. lfgDungeonID = LFGDungeons ID (warcraft.wiki.gg LfgDungeonID: 285 The Headless Horseman, 287 Coren Direbrew, 288 The Crown Chemical Co.). The event is on when the client lists that queue; done today = GetLFGDungeonRewards. Items checked on Wowhead; mountID re-checked in game from the item.

list.name: Coren Direbrew
list.reason: Brewfest, Blackrock Depths; both mounts drop for both factions (wowhead item=33977, item=37828)

list.name: The Crown Chemical Co.
list.reason: Love is in the Air, Shadowfang Keep, from the boss's Heart-Shaped Box (wowhead item=50250)

860._reason: Return to Karazhan has no entrance pin in the client scan; it uses the Karazhan door in Deadwind Pass (same point as Karazhan 745). Reported missing from the route by the player.

760.reason: Onyxia's Lair is in Dustwallow Marsh; the entrance also appears near the edge of Thousand Needles (64) and the heuristic picked that one.

lockoutModels._doc: journalInstanceID -> instance | perBoss | daily | none. Missing = unknown (Verification Required) until validated in v0.3.
